parameters.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.nombre)
    FROM (
      SELECT p.id,
             p.nombre,
             p.activo,
             p.cliente_id,
             c.nombre AS cliente,
             COALESCE(
               json_agg(pa.alias ORDER BY pa.alias) FILTER (WHERE pa.alias IS NOT NULL),
               '[]'::json
             ) AS alias
      FROM proyectos p
      JOIN clientes c ON c.id = p.cliente_id
      LEFT JOIN proyecto_alias pa ON pa.proyecto_id = p.id
      GROUP BY p.id, p.nombre, p.activo, p.cliente_id, c.nombre
    ) x
  ), '[]'::json) AS proyectos,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', c.id, 'nombre', c.nombre) ORDER BY c.nombre)
    FROM clientes c
    WHERE c.activo
  ), '[]'::json) AS clientes,
  (SELECT to_json(a)
   FROM admin_pending a
   WHERE a.usuario_id = $1
     AND a.accion = 'modo'
     AND a.actualizado_en > now() - interval '2 hours'
   LIMIT 1) AS pendiente;

parameters.query:
WITH proy AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.nombre, p.activo, c.nombre AS cliente,
         GREATEST(
           similarity(unaccent(lower(p.nombre)), unaccent(lower($1::text))),
           COALESCE(MAX(similarity(unaccent(lower(pa.alias)), unaccent(lower($1::text)))), 0)
         ) AS score
  FROM proyectos p
  JOIN clientes c ON c.id = p.cliente_id
  LEFT JOIN proyecto_alias pa ON pa.proyecto_id = p.id
  WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL AND $1::text <> ''
  GROUP BY p.id, p.nombre, p.activo, c.nombre
),
cli AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.nombre,
         similarity(unaccent(lower(c.nombre)), unaccent(lower($2::text))) AS score
  FROM clientes c
  WHERE $2::text IS NOT NULL AND $2::text <> ''
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'nombre', nombre, 'activo', activo, 'cliente', cliente, 'score', score) ORDER BY score DESC)
    FROM (SELECT * FROM proy WHERE score >= 0.25 ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 3) x
  ), '[]'::json) AS proyecto_candidatos,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'nombre', nombre, 'score', score) ORDER BY score DESC)
    FROM (SELECT * FROM cli WHERE score >= 0.25 ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 3) x
  ), '[]'::json) AS cliente_candidatos,
  $3::jsonb AS operacion;

parameters.query:
WITH datos AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS accion, $2::jsonb AS payload
),
cliente_nuevo AS (
  INSERT INTO clientes (nombre)
  SELECT payload->>'cliente_nombre'
  FROM datos
  WHERE accion = 'crear'
    AND COALESCE(payload->>'cliente_id', '') = ''
  ON CONFLICT (nombre) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
cliente AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    NULLIF(payload->>'cliente_id', '')::int,
    (SELECT id FROM cliente_nuevo),
    (SELECT id FROM clientes WHERE unaccent(lower(nombre)) = unaccent(lower(payload->>'cliente_nombre')) LIMIT 1)
  ) AS id
  FROM datos
),
crear AS (
  INSERT INTO proyectos (cliente_id, nombre)
  SELECT cliente.id, payload->>'nombre'
  FROM datos, cliente
  WHERE accion = 'crear' AND cliente.id IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (nombre) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, nombre, 'creado'::text AS resultado
),
editar AS (
  UPDATE proyectos p
  SET nombre = COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'nuevo_nombre', ''), p.nombre)
  FROM datos
  WHERE accion = 'editar'
    AND p.id = NULLIF(payload->>'proyecto_id', '')::int
  RETURNING p.id, p.nombre, 'editado'::text AS resultado
),
estado AS (
  UPDATE proyectos p
  SET activo = (accion = 'reactivar')
  FROM datos
  WHERE accion IN ('desactivar', 'reactivar')
    AND p.id = NULLIF(payload->>'proyecto_id', '')::int
  RETURNING p.id, p.nombre, accion AS resultado
),
alias_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO proyecto_alias (proyecto_id, alias)
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT id FROM crear), (SELECT id FROM editar)),
         a.alias
  FROM datos,
       jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(payload->'alias', '[]'::jsonb)) AS a(alias)
  WHERE accion IN ('crear', 'editar')
    AND COALESCE((SELECT id FROM crear), (SELECT id FROM editar)) IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT * FROM crear
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM editar
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM estado;
